limitations: One serial/parallel throughput pair on one machine; descriptive timing, no statistical confidence or portable speed guarantee.
All calibration attempts reach the capped 13-evaluation budget and remain partial; success labels execution and exact trace parity only.
Parallel workers contend for CPU/memory and reuse process-wide caches within a worker; includes startup and case reports, with no separate warm-up.
Dataset reference is not independent metrology; provider training overlap remains possible.

metrics.interpretation: Through all case reports, including startup/load/serialization; summary writing excluded.

protocol.failure_policy: Keep failed/partial attempts; never substitute a backend or discard a case.
protocol.initial_estimate_policy: Dataset reference plus local Euler rotation +/-0.5 deg and camera-frame translation +/-0.5 m, on x, y, z in that order. Controlled prior; reference is never the optimization target.
protocol.split_policy: One paired throughput observation covering the same six fixed cases and 20/5 frame split.
protocol.tuning_policy: All cases/settings fixed before execution; no holdout tuning or filtering.
